detectra ai: sms & pdf scam detection with automated alert system aparna manojkumar dixit registration no: bcs under the guidance of prof. s.m. bansode department of computer science shri guru gobind singhji institute of engineering and technology vishnupuri, nanded may, / overview introduction problem statement objectives methodology block level design workflow components & tools implementation algorithm results work plan future work conclusion references / introduction rapid growth of digital communication has increased sms phishing (smishing) attacks attackers use malicious links to steal sensitive user information traditional spam filters fail to detect evolving and sophisticated scams need for an intelligent, automated detection system detectra ai uses machine learning and nlp to detect scams in sms and pdf documents / problem statement increasing number of sms and pdf-based phishing attacks existing systems lack accuracy and adaptability to new scam patterns malicious content can be embedded within pdf documents absence of real-time detection and alert mechanisms need for a robust ml-based solution for improved security / objectives develop a machine learning model for sms scam detection detect phishing content in pdf documents apply natural language processing (nlp) for text preprocessing design a user-friendly web interface using streamlit implement real-time alert generation for detected threats maintain a logging system for monitoring and analysis / methodology data collection: sms dataset and sample pdf documents text extraction: extract text from pdfs using pypdf preprocessing: cleaning, tokenization, stopword removal, and normalization feature extraction: convert text into numerical vectors using tf-idf model training: train naive bayes classifier on labeled data prediction: classify input as spam or ham system actions: generate real-time alerts store results in message logs analyze word frequency patterns block repeated malicious messages / system architecture input layer: accepts sms messages or pdf documents text processing layer: pdf text extraction and preprocessing (cleaning, tokenization) feature extraction: converts text into tf-idf vectors machine learning layer: naive bayes classifier for prediction output layer: classifies messages as spam or ham security layer: generates alerts, logs data, and blocks repeated threats / system architecture diagram / detectra ai system workflow start input: sms / pdf input type preprocessing naive bayes predictionpdf text extraction preprocessing rule analysis (ratio, structure, keywords) ml prediction final decision (spam / suspicious / safe) alert generation logging system source blocking end / components & tools used programming language: python ml library: scikit-learn (model training and evaluation) frontend framework: streamlit (interactive web interface) pdf processing: pypdf (text extraction from documents) feature engineering: tf-idf vectorizer classification algorithm: naive bayes / implementation developed complete ml pipeline using python collected and preprocessed sms and pdf text data extracted features using tf-idf vectorization trained naive bayes model on labeled dataset integrated pdf text extraction using pypdf designed interactive ui using streamlit implemented: real-time scam detection alert generation system message logging and monitoring blocking mechanism for repeated threats / naive bayes algorithm p(s|m) =p(m|s)p(s) p(m) based on bayes theorem calculates probability of message being spam given input text assumes feature independence (bag-of-words model) works efficiently with high-dimensional text data uses laplace smoothing to handle unseen words / results achieved . % accuracy on test dataset high precision and recall for spam detection successfully detects: sms phishing (smishing) malicious content in pdfs provides real-time predictions generates alerts and maintains logs for analysis / work plan phase : data collection and dataset preparation phase : data preprocessing and cleaning phase : model development (naive bayes) phase : feature extraction using tf-idf phase : ui development using streamlit phase : integration (pdf + sms detection) phase : testing, evaluation, and optimization phase : final deployment and documentation / limitations & future scope limitations: cannot detect scams in image-based or scanned pdfs (no ocr support) model performance depends on dataset quality new and evolving scam patterns may reduce accuracy sensitive to noisy or incomplete text input future scope: integrate ocr for scanned pdf detection upgrade to deep learning models (bert, lstm) enable real-time sms monitoring using apis develop mobile application for wider accessibility deploy system on cloud for scalability / conclusion developed an ai-based scam detection system for sms and pdf data successfully applied machine learning (naive bayes + tf-idf) for text classification achieved high accuracy and reliable performance integrated real-time alert generation, message logging, and blocking system provides a scalable and efficient solution for detecting phishing attacks /
